title: Roof curb for equipment, hatch or skylight

checklist.item: Top of curb is at least 8 in (200 mm) above the finished roof surface, including tapered insulation at its highest.
checklist.why: Curbs set before the insulation end up too low.

checklist.item: Membrane base flashing runs up the curb and is covered by the unit's counter-flashing or cap.
checklist.why: An exposed flashing top is a leak.

checklist.item: A cricket is shown on the high side of curbs wider than 24 in (600 mm).
Curb is insulated and attached to structure; equipment anchorage is referenced.
checklist.why: Wind and seismic loads go through the curb.

checklist.item: Clearance from the curb to other curbs, walls and the roof edge allows the flashing to be installed.
checklist.why: Curbs too close together cannot be flashed.

checklist.item: Curb type, height and the unit it carries are tagged.
checklist.why: The curb is often supplied by another trade.
